prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this supplied pixel-art UI atlas into production-ready reusable sprites. Make ALL background areas genuinely alpha transparent: remove both the printed checkerboard and white gutters. Remove ALL text and numbers from every plaque, banner, button, badge and card, filling only the lettering regions seamlessly with the original wood/parchment surface. Top title banner blank; subtitle banner blank; enemy heading blank; small best record plaque blank. Preserve the three gold stars. Preserve the gold crown on the completion badge but remove the green lettering to its right, leaving the original dark olive badge texture blank. Preserve the crossed swords in the large challenge button but remove all its lettering. Preserve white X icons in all four close buttons. Remove slime and goblin portraits from the two lower-left cards, leaving parchment blank, and remove names from their nameplates. Preserve the empty panels, all leaves, and the three blank dark plaques along the bottom. No new objects, no labels, no shadows outside sprites, no layout changes. Output same wide 3:2 composition as input, a transparent PNG sprite atlas. Do NOT paint checkerboard, real transparency is required.
